clues.text: God told Moses and Aaron to take handfuls of soot from a furnace in Pharaoh's sight.
In Egypt, fine dust spread over the land and these broke out on people and animals alike.
Pharaoh's magicians could not stand before Moses, because this plague had struck them too.
Moses warned that if Israel disobeyed, God would strike them with these of Egypt, plus tumors, scabs and itch.
When King Hezekiah was ill, Isaiah had a lump of pressed figs laid on one, and the king recovered.
Satan left the LORD's presence and struck Job with terrible ones from his feet to his head.
Suffering from these, Job sat among the ashes and scraped himself with a piece of broken pottery.
